text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah—
Pretty good, right?
That was the ultimate cornering!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"We saw, we saw! Super smooth!
Seriously, Heart, your growth is almost scary!"
"Right?! At this rate, you could easily grab a GⅠ!"

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Tch. Playing buddy-buddy like that,
there's no way you're getting any stronger...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was watching training,
I heard that voice beside me.
Looking over, there stood a horse girl with a bitter scowl.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Say.
Is there anyone who wants to run a mock race with me?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I feel like I could deliver
my absolute best performance♪ Anyone up for it?

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: —I'll do it. I'm running.

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
And I'll prove it to you.
That getting chummy like you all do—
won't make you any stronger!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Looks like you're fired up!
That challenge... of course I accept!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Act smug while you still can.
Because I'm the one who's going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparks flying between them, Dearing Heart and the fiercely competitive horse girl entered the track.
And the result of the mock race was—!

text_block_list.name: Heart & Rival
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaaaaah!"
"Yaaaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew, haah. —I win, I win!
First place goes to me!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
"Yay~! We believed in you, Heart!!"
"You held that lead the entire time... Incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: —Haah... Haah, haah...! ...D-Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Go ahead and laugh.
Insult me however you want—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
But I'm so grateful! I'm completely satisfied!
Thanks to you, I pulled off a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
? ...W-What...?
After everything I said to you...
Why are you acting like that...?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm, call it the victor's composure, perhaps!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm just kidding. Just a joke.
—I'm honestly thrilled. To have won against you.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your aura, that sheer drive to overtake me,
was totally different from anyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Winning against someone like that...
It's only natural to be thrilled, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Let's run together again, Challenger-san♪
For you, anytime... welcome!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Ha, hahaha! You said it!
Next time... I will definitely win...!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Wash your neck and wait for me!!

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
......Hmph.
Annoying as always...

text_block_list.name: Rival Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
............
Next time... I won't lose.
